'''Cristoforo''' is an Overseer of the [[Fractsidus]] and a quest-exclusive NPC who makes his first appearance in [[Version 2.0]] during the {{Quest|Through the Sea Thou Break}}. 

== Appearance ==
Cristoforo is a handsome young man of slim build and average height. He has slick, blond hair with short bangs in the front of his forehead tied in a ponytail and narrow green eyes.

== Clothing ==
Cristoforo wears a red tricorn hat that is black inside with golden diamond buttons, three black strands attached to both sides of the brim, yellow eyes over silver scars shaped like cat nail claws and a pair of black feathers attached to the back.

His outfit consists of a white blouse with golden diamond-shaped buttons and an a black jacket featuring a red collar made of a seemingly synthetic material that features a black cape draped over his shoulder, attached by a red strap with a spherical golden buckle over white puffed sleeves with a white trim, red knee pads with white socks shaped like feathers, and black boots with red soles. Additionally, he sometimes dons a black domino mask with golden highlights and a pointed nose shaped like a toucan beak.

==Profile==
Presenting himself as a playwright, Cristoforo initially appears as a individual who possesses great knowledge of various subjects, such as [[Rinascita]] traditions and history.

Although revealed to be an Overseer, his theatrical nature is genuine and almost a metaphor for his true work. Rather than directly driving his plans, he prefers to instead "place characters on their stage," instigating and witnessing situations unfold as people make their own choices that lead to their own undoing. According to [[Phrolova]], he adores the heroic tales told in Rinascita to the point of obsession, and that extends to instigating trials and turbulations that heroes must overcome during their journeys. He is also shown to personally enjoy reveling in the beauty of tragedies and the suffering of others, particularly [[Mya]], as works of art, a trait which other Overseers like Phrolova find detestable.<ref>[[Shadow of Glory]]</ref>

===Resonance===
He is a [[Resonator]], though his [[Tacet Mark]] has yet to be seen. 

His Resonance ability seems to allow him to create a [[Sonoro Sphere]] comparable to a script of a play, where each world within is a repeating story that manifests as reality.<ref>[[Flames of Heart]]</ref> This requires inspiration in the form of a narrative anchor based on past events, and he cannot stray too far from the framework of the original story. However, whenever a story repeats, any changes bleed through into the new pages.

Within these stories, everyone has an assigned role, and to lose one's role results in a loss of identity and memory, ultimately leading to the complete erasure of one's existence.

His ability seems to be capable of reshaping reality in turn, but the extent of this is currently unknown. He has previously been shown to manifest the imagination and fear shared by the minds of an audience, such as the Ragunessi, into real life.<ref>[[Your Summer Will Never Wither/Story]]</ref>

==Story==
===History===
Years ago in [[Ragunna]], Cristoforo met the members of the [[Golden Anthem]] in [[Whisperwind Haven]] while claiming to be common artists. Suggesting they sing for the people of Ragunna rather than solely for the Divinity, he guided them to a lithograph depicting the true form of Imperator, prompting them to turn against the Order and attempt to share the truth, ultimately leading to their deaths aboard the [[Pilgrim's Sail]].

===Present===
Claiming to be a playwright visiting [[Ragunna]] in search of inspiration for his work, Cristoforo first appears in [[Through the Sea Thou Break]], stopping [[Rover]] from intervening with the [[Pilgrim's Sail]]. With the explanation of working on scripts about the [[Pilgrim's Sail]] and the [[Cartethyia|Blessed Maiden]], he appears several times in {{Quest|Chapter II}}, providing some guidance and information to Rover.

During [[What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing]], he is revealed to be an Overseer<ref>[[What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing]] Dialogue Summary — (''Not far away, Phrolova watches your every move. Beside her stands another Overseer, Cristoforo the "Playwright." It seems his script is only starting to unfold....'')</ref> of the [[Fractsidus]], working with [[Phrolova]], and is responsible for orchestrating events in Rinascita.

==Trivia==
* While not officially marked as part of the quest, Cristoforo appears inside the [[Averardo Vault]] during [[Veils Off in Sun or Shadow]], where he can optionally be spoken to.
** Given his proximity at the time, he is likely the 'Lord Overseer' mentioned by the Fractsidus members encountered outside the vault.
* [[Farroll]] of Golden Anthem comments that Cristoforo's speech indicates he is of Rinascita's nobility. [[Ciaccona]] also questions this.
** Despite this, Ragunna nobles such as [[Carlotta]] do not seem to recognize him, even when meeting him unmasked.
